adds.title: Basic Court of Pristina - Blert Morina ruling, December 2019
adds.summary: In December 2019 the Basic Court of Pristina granted Blert Morina legal change of name and sex marker, establishing that gender identity in Kosovo can be legally recognized without proof of surgical intervention or other medical change.

adds.title: Ministry of Justice and Civil Registration Agency - post-judgment position
adds.summary: In January 2020 Blert Morina obtained legal change of name and sex marker in Kosovo, with the court recognizing the right to gender identity without requiring evidence of surgical intervention or any medical change.

adds.title: Official websites of Center for Equality and Liberty (CEL) and Center for Social Group Development (CSGD)
adds.summary: In Kosovo CSGD provides LGBTQI+ people free confidential legal aid and psychological support in person and online via app.csgd-ks.org, tailored reproductive and sexual health services including support navigating hormonal procedures for transgender people in cooperation with the Ministry and free HIV testing, with free PrEP HIV-prevention treatment available at the QKUK Infectious Disease Clinic since June 12, 2024 following CSGD advocacy.
